item.title: The Mercury's 2026 Spring Arts Preview: We Need Art to Survive
item.description: You don’t have to have an art focus to benefit from art. by Suzette Smith It was staff writer Lindsay Costello who inspired this issue’s theme. During a new year discussion about our team’s goals, she mentioned: “More and more, I am realizing that we need art to survive.” The phrase seemed deeply relevant, working in two ways: We need art to survive for our personal enrichment and enjoyment.
